Monday, 27 March 2023

Recruitment for the post of Medical Physicist cum RSO
(SC-1 & open-1)
in the department of Radiotherapy.
Qualification & Experience:
The candidate must have M.Sc. in Medical Physics from a recognized Institute/University and minimum 12 months of internship in a recognized radiation therapy department
OR
MSc in Physics with Diploma in Radiological/Medical physics from BARC or from AERB recognized university/institution and minimum 12 months of internship in a recognized radiation therapy department, person with 2 years’ experience in the Radiotherapy Department in a Medical College, will be preferred. He/ She should also have a Radiological Safety Officer (RSO) certificate.
Eligible candidates should submit the applications on the Prescribed format completed in all aspects with certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates must reach to the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha – 442102, Maharashtra (email: secretaryoffice@ mgims.ac.in) latest by
15/04/2023
.
Salary
:
As admissible under the rules of Kasturba Health Society.
Age: Upper age limit 38 years for open category and 43 years for reserved category.
Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts or cancel the interview or entire selection process.
Click here to download the application form
SECRETARY
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
